comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
RCA + implementation evidence (docs-only Verify)

Problem: Gerrit Verify scheduled the full build/test OS×Python matrix plus mutation, packaging, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs for every patchset because gerrit-verify.yaml had no changed-path routing seam. A pure documentation change therefore consumed the same runners and wall clock as executable changes.

Proven mechanism: the workflow's unconditional job graph was the changeable artifact. A held-out workflow oracle failed before repair with "Gerrit Verify has no trusted route-classification job". The background fixer added a trusted-main classifier and reduced lane. Independent review then found three incomplete-coverage mechanisms: (1) make lint's check_dco_identity.py and check_criteria_vocabulary.py documentation guards were absent from the reduced lane; (2) conflict-marker and added-large-file hooks relevant to prose/images were absent; (3) target-branch workflow definitions can reference the extracted local composite action while an older open patchset's tree predates that action. Each was observed RED before repair through held-out or structural tests. The final action runs those reduced-only guards and a conservative docs-contract pytest selection; both workflows materialize trusted main's action only when the checked-out patchset lacks it.

OSS comparison (current upstream main branches, researched 2026-08-14):
- CPython .github/workflows/reusable-context.yml + Tools/build/compute-changes.py compute run-docs/run-tests outputs, skip regular tests for Doc/Misc/documentation suffixes, retain docs and C-API-doc checks, and run full tests for non-doc paths.
- astral-sh/ruff .github/workflows/ci.yaml has a determine_changes job; docs/** and assets/** alone set code=false, expensive Rust/test jobs require code=true, and the mkdocs job remains required. Ruff explicitly warns that not every Markdown file is documentary because some Markdown files are tests.
- Django tests.yml uses paths-ignore: docs/** while docs.yml is selected by docs/** and performs a dedicated docs build.
- pandas unit-tests.yml ignores doc/** and web/**, while docbuild-and-upload.yml owns documentation/website validation.
- FastAPI uses a paths-filter classifier for test and docs jobs; its docs-affecting set conservatively includes pyproject.toml, uv.lock, workflow files, and scripts/docs.py, matching this ticket's decision that configuration, locks, workflows/actions, and scripts route to full Verify.

This is OSS consensus: change-aware test routing plus a dedicated documentation validation lane, with config/build inputs treated as executable impact. The rebar implementation is intentionally stricter than native paths-ignore because Gerrit workflow_dispatch requires the classifier and complete allowlist to execute from trusted origin/main, and every uncertainty routes full.

Verification:
- Held-out oracle: RED before classifier; GREEN after repair; exact missing DCO guard mutation returned RED; restored GREEN.
- Older-patchset/action-skew oracle: RED without trusted-main fallback; GREEN after fallback.
- Conservative docs contract selection: 2,417 passed, 15 skipped in 114.15s locally (non-integration/non-external; roughly 80% of the default suite skipped).
- Direct documentation guards: ADR number/cross-reference, ADR index, env registry, docs index/dead links, README quickstart, CLI reference, MCP reference, DCO identity, and criteria vocabulary all passed.
- Pre-commit docs hygiene: merge-conflict and added-large-file hooks passed.
- Focused classifier/workflow/structural suite: 338 passed.
- make lint, actionlint, YAML validation, make typecheck (540 files), and git diff --check passed.
- No new dependency and no weakened test; full-route coverage/jobs remain intact and gain no additional docs runner job.

compiled_state.description:
## Context
Documentation-only Gerrit changes currently consume the complete OS/Python matrix plus mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, and golden-path jobs. The operator approved a reduced lane only when trusted classification proves every changed path is documentary. Python, shell, workflows/actions, dependencies/locks, builds, tests/fixtures, configuration/policy, unknown paths, and unavailable diffs always select full Verify. Docs-only Verify retains every documentation-related generated-doc, drift, index, cross-reference, quickstart, and reference-validation gate.

## Trust and diff contract
The routing decision controls Verified and therefore runs only from trusted `origin/main`, mirroring the existing trusted-main vote normalizer. The routing job checks out the exact patchset as data and separately sparse-checks out the classifier plus complete allowlist from `origin/main` with credentials disabled. It never imports, sources, or executes patchset-controlled classifier logic or configuration. The exact change set is `HEAD^..HEAD`; the job explicitly deepens the mirror-first checkout until `HEAD^` resolves, using the existing dependency-audit pattern. A normally completing classifier emits `route=full` for parent-resolution failure, an empty or malformed path list, or any non-allowlisted path. If the classifier job itself fails or is cancelled before emitting an output, every full-route job uses `always() && (needs.classifier.result != 'success' || needs.classifier.outputs.route == 'full')` and therefore still runs; the docs-only job requires classifier success plus `route=docs-only` and cannot run. The failed classifier result remains in `vote.needs` and blocks Verified even when fallback full jobs pass.

Native GitHub `paths:` and patchset-local filtering are rejected because this workflow is Gerrit `workflow_dispatch` and the security-sensitive decision must not come from the untrusted patchset tree. The new classifier may reuse the existing `dependency_audit.changed_files` parsing seam from trusted main if its error contract fits; otherwise it must preserve the same fail-closed semantics.

## Shared documentation gates
Inventory the current inline gates and extract only the documentation-relevant steps into `.github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml`. Both callers first perform their already-required checkout and Python/uv setup, then invoke the same composite action. The action does not own checkout. This form avoids adding a new runner/job to the full lane while single-sourcing gate commands; a separate reusable-workflow job was rejected because it would increase full-lane runner usage, contrary to the contention constraint. Inline copies are removed.

Preflight and migrate every structural consumer that reads `_build-and-test.yml`: `test_gate_step_tree_skew.py`, `test_ci_workflow_parity.py`, `test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py`, `test_check_config_reads_heldout.py`, `test_complexity_baseline.py`, `test_extra_coverage_guard.py`, `test_git_floor_gate_tree_skew.py`, `test_dependency_advisory_wiring.py`, and `test_worktree_python_pin.py`. Each affected invariant must follow the extracted action rather than be weakened or deleted; consumers of gates that remain inline stay unchanged.

## Routing and aggregation
- Add an unconditional trusted classifier job after clear-vote and ticket resolution.
- A proven docs-only patchset runs one Ubuntu docs-only job that invokes the shared action.
- Full build/test, mutation, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs run only on the full route.
- Add classifier and docs-only results to `vote.needs`; make normalization route-aware so exactly one route must execute and skipped jobs from the other route are neutral. A classifier-job failure runs the full fallback route and also blocks Verified. A missing lane, executed-job failure, or docs-gate failure blocks Verified.
- Update `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` and its tests so the docs-only gate cannot be omitted from vote aggregation.
- Create parameterized `tests/scripts/test_classify_gerrit_verify_change.py` cases for every documented path category, exact `HEAD^..HEAD` parent handling, malformed/empty input, classifier exceptions, and the successful docs-only control; gate them with `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_classify_gerrit_verify_change.py`.
- Preserve clear-vote, resolvable-ticket, secret, and vote-key boundaries.
- Document the allowlist rationale, fail-closed rule, and safe extension process in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- Measure the first genuine docs-only run against change 1778 / run 31817494677. Back-out is a Gerrit revert restoring unconditional full Verify.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Allowlisted documentation-only paths select the docs-only route.
- [ ] Any Python path selects full Verify.
- [ ] Any shell or executable path selects full Verify.
- [ ] Any workflow or action path selects full Verify.
- [ ] Any dependency or lockfile path selects full Verify.
- [ ] Any test or fixture path selects full Verify.
- [ ] Any repository configuration or policy path selects full Verify.
- [ ] Any unrecognized path selects full Verify.
- [ ] An empty, malformed, unreadable, or parentless diff selects full Verify.
- [ ] Classifier logic and the complete allowlist execute only from trusted `origin/main`.
- [ ] A patchset modifying routing logic, workflow, or action cannot select docs-only Verify.
- [ ] Documentation gates have one extracted definition and no copied command list.
- [ ] The shared gate retains ADR number, index, and cross-reference validation.
- [ ] The shared gate retains docs-index and README quickstart validation.
- [ ] The shared gate retains CLI, MCP, and env-registry drift validation.
- [ ] The inventory test retains every other current documentation-related guard.
- [ ] Existing workflow-structure tests follow extracted gates without losing assertions.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify skips the OS/Python matrix and mutation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify skips optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs.
- [ ] Full Verify uses no additional runner job for documentation gates.
- [ ] The resolvable-ticket and clear-vote gates remain unconditional.
- [ ] `vote.needs` includes every route result required for fail-closed Verified.
- [ ] A classifier job failure still runs every full-route job.
- [ ] A classifier job failure cannot yield Verified +1.
- [ ] A failed documentation gate cannot yield Verified +1.
- [ ] Workflow policy tests, lint, and typecheck pass.
- [ ] `CONTRIBUTING.md` explains the docs-only allowlist contract and safe extension rule.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Gerrit LLM-Review reaches +1; record change, patchset, vote, and timestamp.
  provenance: environment=production Gerrit; principal=rebar-review-bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the production review bot vote is the contract.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Gerrit Verified reaches +1; record change, workflow run, patchset, vote, and timestamp.
  provenance: environment=production GitHub Actions and Gerrit; principal=rebar-ci-bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the production CI vote exercises the deployed workflow.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The merged SHA and merge timestamp are recorded before closure.
  provenance: environment=production Gerrit; principal=authenticated submitter; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Gerrit merge state is authoritative.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Genuine docs-only wall clock and runner-minutes are compared with run 31817494677.
  provenance: environment=production GitHub Actions; principal=rebar-ci-bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — production job timestamps and conclusions provide the measurement.
